main.description: Record representing an owner-authored grant of capabilities to a member. The record key is the stable membership id from PostgreSQL. This record is the portable grant; a record written by the member must never be treated as authorization.

member.description: DID of the account granted access.

permissions.description: Capabilities granted to the member. An empty list is read-only (viewer) access.

subject.description: Strong reference to the owner's at.marque.team record.

updatedAt.description: When the grant was last updated.

description: An accepted team member grant, authored by the domain owner. Stored in the owner's repository.
